rescale_detector_results: rescale detector prediction boxes, masks, and keypoints to a target output resolution
resize_instance_predictions: resize raw R-CNN detector output instances to a different image resolution
clip_boxes_to_image: scale and clip predicted bounding boxes to fit within the target image boundaries
upsample_sem_seg_logits: upsample semantic segmentation prediction logits to the original image resolution
convert_roi_masks_to_bitmasks: convert ROI mask predictions to bitmasks at the desired output resolution
